kitfights.name: Kit Fights
kitfights.description: Sword, Nethpot, Crystal, Mace, Spear, UHC, Helden and more — across 12 unique maps. Includes special modes: MLG Rush, Spleef, Sumo, and Boxing.

solotraining.name: Solo Training
solotraining.description: Train your Crystal PvP, Sword, and Mace mechanics against AI bots. Available 24/7 — no partner needed. Perfect for grinding your mechanics solo.

bedwars.name: BedWars
bedwars.description: A fully dedicated BedWars server with multiple maps and modes. Protect your bed, gather resources, upgrade your team and wipe out the competition before they destroy yours.

communityevents.name: Community Events
communityevents.description: Regular community events to keep things fresh. From PvP tournaments with brackets and prizes to 24-hour SMP challenges — there's always something to look forward to.
